messages:
nina (support): FYI inbound from Velox Health — they want to onboard lysander-13b (open model) and pin the EU+IN regions. Request includes 4-bit quant support and a dedicated version pin. Asking for ETA and SLA info.

jim (sales): +1 from deal team. They want predictable latency for inference (p95 < 200ms at 8k context) and data residency in India. This is a potential Dedicated customer after POC.

sarah (product): Thanks. Quick clarifying Qs: 1) Do they need private deployment (VPC/on‑prem) or hosted with geo-pin? 2) Any custom fine-tuning or just base model?

nina (support): Hosted with geo-pin only for now. No FT at onboarding — just base quantized variant. They want version pin so model upgrades don't break validated prompts.

leo (infra): India (IN) capacity note: current IN pool has limited A100 headroom next quarter. We can offer a soft-pin (route -> IN primary, fallback to EU) or reserve Dedicated nodes.

mike (runtime): lysander-13b runs on our build but we haven't validated 4-bit quant path for it. Need perf bench: token throughput, latency, and memory. Also confirm KV-cache behaviour for long context.

ana (legal): Export-control check: lysander is permissive open model but double-check the license and training data origin. If customer processes regulated PHI, we need DPIA and SOC docs.

jim (sales): Velox will process PHI in some flows. They'll need SOC2 + BAA conversation. That impacts Private/Dedicated decision.

sarah (product): Ok — product assessment plan: 1) Quick license review (legal) 2) Runtime perf validation of 4-bit quant (eng-ml + runtime) 3) Region capacity check and fallback policy (infra) 4) Catalog entry + version pin + rollout plan (product/catalog) 5) Compliance gating (legal/support). Can we write acceptance criteria?

mike (runtime): Acceptance criteria (proposed): - Quantized 4-bit variant passes accuracy smoke tests on our eval set (no >5% degradation vs fp16 on core prompt set) - p95 latency <200ms at target load (simulated 20 qps) in IN region or via routed fallback <220ms - memory fits on a single A100 (or with KV-cache < 80GB) - streaming + KV cache works for 8k context.

leo (infra): Ops criteria: - Route policy defined: IN primary, EU fallback automatic. - Capacity plan: soft-pin available immediately, Dedicated reservation estimate within 2 weeks if needed. - Cost delta estimate for customer (IN pin surcharge).

ana (legal): Compliance criteria: - Confirm license OK for commercial use - If PHI in scope, BAA needed and Private/Dedicated conversation flagged.

catalog-bot: Checklist created: catalog/requests/1764512345-velox-lysander13b-checklist. Steps: license-check, runtime-bench, infra-capacity, compliance-gate, catalog-entry, pin-config.

sarah (product): TL;DR and next steps: 1) Legal to confirm license + BAA flag (ana) 2) Runtime to run 4-bit perf/eval (mike) 3) Infra to confirm IN capacity and fallback policy (leo) 4) Support to keep Velox in the loop on ETA (nina) 5) Product will schedule a small canary rollout and define rollback criteria. Please post updates in this thread.

nina (support): I'll ACK with Velox — tell them ETA ~2 weeks for initial validation, caveat on PHI/BAA.

jim (sales): Perfect. If validation looks good we'll push for Dedicated commit. Keep me looped for POC pricing.

sarah (product): Assigning tentative priority: P1 for catalog backlog (customer-driven, PHI + potential Dedicated revenue). If legal requires BAA/private, scope shifts.

mike (runtime): I'll start perf runs tomorrow and post logs here.

leo (infra): I'll model IN soft-pin cost and available capacity by EOD Fri.

ana (legal): I'll finish license check tomorrow and flag BAA path if PHI confirmed.

sarah (product): Great. I'll create a product ticket with acceptance criteria and link to catalog checklist. Leave updates here. :thumbsup:
